item.description: Our goal has been to create some of the best cyber-capable models, and we have worked hard to ensure that we provide tools for our users, making it as easy and affordable as possible to access the best models available. All of this has been made possible through your support. We have been working hard to make it easy for anyone to get into bug bounties and earn some cash from them. For example, Pixilated has made some money from bug bounties through the Samsung program, which we all discovered using our models and methodologies. Long story short, we are here to kill the barrier between researchers who are getting into cyber and those who already understand what’s going on. Check out our new platform, still in BETA, and we are working on open-sourcing the desktop version of it. https://cnsecurity.cyberneurova.ai
